newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Pop singer Sade on driving charges in Jamaica.
newsitem.headline: Pop singer Sade on driving charges in Jamaica.

text.p: Pop singer Sade has appeared in a Montego Bay court to face charges of dangerous driving, disobeying a police officer and disorderly conduct, police said on Tuesday.
She is scheduled to be tried June 25.
Police alleged that the Nigerian-born singer, whose full name is Helen Folasade, was driving in Montego Bay on Feb. 27 when she disobeyed a policeman's signal for her to stop at a busy intersection.
She was detained after another officer chased her. She was released on bail and appeared in court on Monday.
Local newspapers said Sade had been living near the resort town of Ocho Rios since last year.
